description: Stop: refuse to end the turn while a dispatched madbench:operator has not reported back. Every Agent call in this build is asynchronous, so the parent's reply closes the session and kills the operator mid-run. The command text says three times to block on TaskOutput; measured on MBN-1 with --repeat 5 twice, parents that actually waited were 3/5 then 2/5, so the wording is replaced by a mechanism. The hook is silent unless the transcript holds an operator dispatch with no terminal task-notification after it, and it gives up — allowing the turn to end — on an unreadable transcript, a dispatch older than 45 minutes, or after 6 consecutive blocks for the same task id.
